FISHING LICENCE · BELIZE

Belize fishing licence

Belize's sport fishing licence programme covers shore, reef, flats and offshore sport fishing. Bonefish, tarpon and permit must be released; a licence does not allow you to keep them.

Buy a licence online ↗Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-11

Who needs one

  • Anglers participating in sport fishing under the CZMAI licence programme.

Licence options and prices

LicenceForLengthPrice
Sport fishing dailyany1 dayBZD 20
Sport fishing weeklyany1 weekBZD 50
Sport fishing annualany1 yearBZD 100

Extra stamps and permits

  • Hol Chan sport fishing user fee · BZD 20
    Required per person per day in the designated sport fishing area.

Saltwater

The programme includes shore, reef, offshore and flats fishing. Marine reserve licences and zone rules can also apply.

Rules visitors should know

  • Release all bonefish, tarpon and permit.
  • Do not fish in Hol Chan's closed zones.
  • Present photo identification for an annual licence.

How to buy

Buy short licences online. Buy an annual licence at CZMAI's office or an approved distributor.

Common license questions

Do I need a fishing licence in Belize?

Belize's sport fishing licence programme covers shore, reef, flats and offshore sport fishing. Bonefish, tarpon and permit must be released; a licence does not allow you to keep them.

How much is a visitor fishing licence in Belize?

Sport fishing daily: BZD 20; Sport fishing weekly: BZD 50; Sport fishing annual: BZD 100 (checked November 2026).

Where do I buy a fishing licence in Belize?

Buy short licences online. Buy an annual licence at CZMAI's office or an approved distributor.
